summary: NICE Ltd. furnished a routine Form 6-K containing two press releases announcing industry analyst recognitions: placement in the Leaders category of the IDC MarketScape for Worldwide Agentic Contact Center-as-a-Service Platforms 2026 (doc #US54117326, August 2026) and in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Contact Center as a Service. No transaction, shareholder action, capital event or board change is disclosed. The filing references the prior 2025 acquisition of NICE Cognigy only as background to product strategy. No deal terms, advisors or regulatory clocks apply; there is no risk-arb angle to watch.
